titles.romaji: Cofun Gal no Coffy Campus Life
titles.native: 古墳ギャルのコフィー　キャンパスライフ

description: The sequel to Cofun Gal no Coffy (TV). This is a college campus life comedy about 20-year-old college student Coffy, her boyfriend Nintoku-kun, her childhood friend Daniel, her love rival Dorothy, and Okehazama-sensei, who quit being a teacher and became the chief of the college mart.
